notes: AK 2025 vintage available on Justia. Title 24 (Legislature and Lobbying) chosen at pass 1 - title name explicitly names the lobbying regime. Pass 2 selected Chapter 45 (Regulation of Lobbying). Pass-3 fetch on chapter-45 returned 5 article-level TOC URLs (Article 1-5); per dispatch instructions (article URLs are TOC pages, not statute leaves), recursed pass-3 into each article to enumerate section-level leaves. Tree is 6 levels deep: state -> vintage -> title -> chapter -> article -> section. Total 20 section-level leaves enumerated, matching the 2015 ground-truth section count for AS 24.45 exactly. No vintage substitution required; no Cloudflare blocks.
